behavior: A popup that takes its name from its trigger follows the `id` of the trigger element while it is open. When the `id` prop of the trigger, an `id` attribute or the `#render` slot gives the element a new id, the `aria-labelledby` of the Navigation Menu popup gets that id. Base UI reads the `id` of the trigger element when a part of the menu renders. A change of the attribute that changes no state of the menu, such as a new id from the `render` element of the trigger, thus can leave an `aria-labelledby` that names no element.
